question.problem:
$$
T=[\begin{aligned}5 & 3 \\ -2 & 4 \\ 3 & -1\end{aligned}]\,\,T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}3y+ax \\ bx+4y \\ cy+3x\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the standard matrix $T$ of the linear transformation $T:{R}^{2}\to {R}^{3}$ shown above. What is the value of $a+b+c?$
question.worked_solution:
Given the vector $\,[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]\,$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}5 & 3 \\ -2 & 4 \\ 3 & -1\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}5x+3y \\ -2x+4y \\ 3x-y\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}3y+5x \\ -2x+4y \\ -y+3x\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the linear transformation $T$ is given by

$$
T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}3y+5x \\ (-2)x+4y \\ (-1)y+3x\end{aligned}].
$$

Finally, $a+b+c=5+(-2)+(-1)=2.$
